description: Two separate semitone quantizers, each rounding its input to the nearest semitone at a volt per octave

params.text: Mixes the untouched input back into the quantized note: none at noon, all of it fully clockwise, and counter-clockwise the distance to the note is subtracted, bending the pitch the other way

inputs.text: The pitch to be quantized, at a volt per octave

outputs.text: The quantized pitch, at a volt per octave

notes: both quantizers work polyphonically and round every channel of the cable
